dish_drainer_compound_2_folding.notes: THIS POSITION BREAKS TWO RULES THE REGISTRY HAD DERIVED, AND IT BREAKS THEM ON THE SAME PAGE. (1) It has TWO racks, one per module, AND it prints 'In compound wall units, the dish-drainer rack is fitted in the widest unit' - where PG1092/PG1292, the identically shaped two-rack position at H.84, prints nothing. Same door type, same module splits, same rack count, opposite sentence: the sentence is BOILERPLATE APPLIED UNEVENLY and its presence must be read off each page and never derived. See the dated correction in dish_drainer_h84.json. (2) It carries 'cannot be reduced in width', where every compound dish-drainer read before it does NOT - so 'the compounds are where the catalog stops forbidding it' was a pattern in the pages read so far and not a rule either. See the dated correction in dish_drainer_h48.json.
